name: _cw_live
label: CW live decode — NCDXF W6WX beacon (ad-hoc, not shipped)
ai_notes: Ad-hoc bring-up flowgraph proving the fldigi CW (Morse) decoder on the NCDXF/IARU beacon W6WX, 14.100 MHz, Mt Umunhum (~15 mi from San Jose) — 24/7, every 3 min: 'W6WX' @ 22 WPM + dashes, 100 W. SDRplay RSPdx, Antenna C long wire. Dial set ~700 Hz below 14.100 MHz so the beacon tone lands in fldigi's CW capture range. Headless: decode -> tracing decoder::fldigi. Not shipped (catalog_visible:false).
